stem: Which detail from the selection supports the idea that the island benefits from the red crabs?

options.label: A
options.text: Millions of red crabs live in the rain forest that grows on the island.

options.label: B
options.text: The red crabs lay their eggs along the shore of the island.

options.label: C
options.text: The red crab migration attracts many visitors who spend money on the island.

options.label: D
options.text: The red crabs cover roadways during their migration.

notes: Extracted from a 2016 STAAR test question 23.
